scope: Source and license verification, partial traces of one published result per source, and preliminary decisions. No source was executed for this record and no training was launched. Vero development measurements made before this record are cited as evidence.

gate.question: What is the native unit: theorem, specification, function, repository, binary entry point, or another grouped object?
What training-environment decision can be made before downstream outcomes are opened?
Are there at least three independently defined candidates and a competent simple baseline?
Can candidate membership, a target, and a choose-or-abstain rule be frozen without reading the scored outcome?
Does the setting add a new proof assistant, programming language, repository regime, specification type, or real-software target?
Are the official paper, repository, revision, task data, verifier, checkpoints, and training code identifiable and accessible?
Do the repository, task data, and any training data carry licenses that permit research use and derived training data?
Can one published result be traced from native source through verifier and training to its evaluation endpoint?
Are tasks grouped before splitting by repository, source family, or shared generation lineage?
Can exact duplicates, near duplicates, reference-proof leakage, future-lemma leakage, and generated-family leakage be audited?
Are trusted axioms, admitted proofs, unsafe declarations, verifier shortcuts, and infrastructure failures visible rather than collapsed into success or reward zero?
Does the task test proof construction, code-and-proof synthesis, specification construction, or specification faithfulness, with these endpoints kept separate?
Has Anarres run the official verifier at the pinned revision with positive and negative controls?
Can a pinned starting policy be run repeatedly before candidate training?
Does a starting policy that can be trained here show nonzero, non-saturated strict support?
Which source-native measurements represent support, mixed outcomes, effective coverage, verifier feedback, context size, proof cost, and missing execution?
Which quantities are available before training, and which use downstream outcomes?
Can matched-exposure random, difficulty, length or cost, source-native, policy-relative, and compact combined candidates be constructed?
Can measurement and calibration cost be charged explicitly?
Do verifier cost and starting-policy probe cost fit the available budget?
Is the training, evaluation, storage, and accelerator cost of the candidate panel estimated for a named trainable starting policy?
What is the smallest official smoke test that validates the complete source and verifier path?
What access restrictions, dependency size, checker memory, wall time, and proprietary model or artifact dependencies apply?
Have the duplicate, near-duplicate, reference-proof, and starting-policy contamination audits been run on the proposed candidates and target?

Is the matched-exposure panel drafted with fixed random selection, a source-native baseline, the strongest published rule, a policy-relative rule, and one combined rule, together with candidate construction, starting policy, target, verifier, trusted assumptions, budget, seeds, evaluation, uncertainty, measurement cost, and choose-or-abstain conditions?

gate_tiers.panel_freeze: required before a prospective panel is frozen. Every source lists an unresolved entry for each open one.
gate_tiers.record: recorded for comparison and does not change the decision

selection_rule.fixed_before: any source smoke test for this comparison. It was written after the Vero Leanstral-1.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol development measurements, which it cites as evidence.

criteria.text: an honest held-out environment decision exists
the official verifier and outcome path are reproducible
a capable starting-policy probe is feasible
candidate construction preserves repository and generation lineage
random and strong simple baselines can be matched fairly
compute and checker cost fit the available budget
the source expands the current evidence boundary
failures, trusted assumptions, and specification adequacy remain visible

selection_rule.criterion_status: the most severe status among the mapped checks, ordered pass < unresolved < fail
decision: reject when a source_selection check fails and records no remediation
reserve when any other source_selection check is unresolved or fails
proceed when every source_selection check passes

decision_meaning.proceed: selected as the prospective source. A proceed decision does not freeze a panel or authorize training while any panel_freeze check is open.
decision_meaning.reserve: kept for later use. The listed unresolved checks name what must change.
decision_meaning.reject: not used for this program without new evidence

selection_rule.selection: Among proceed sources, select the one with the fewest open panel_freeze checks, then by source_id. With no proceed source, abstain and name the first reserve source as the leading candidate.
selection_rule.reserve_ranking: Order reserve sources by failed criteria, then by unresolved source_selection checks, then by unresolved criteria, then by source_id.
selection_rule.smoke_test_rule: Recommend official source smoke tests for the first two reserve sources, in ranking order, whose verifier_reproduced check is open and whose smoke_test_identified check passes.
selection_rule.policy_pilot_rule: When the leading candidate's policy_headroom check is open, recommend a development-only starting-policy pilot for it. A policy pilot is separate from source smoke tests.
selection_rule.evidence_rule: A pass needs at least one confirmed evidence claim. A check with an open unresolved entry cannot pass. An unresolved entry blocks the tier of the check it names.

steps: choose the OSS Verify pin (an immutable release tag, or 89eb8357 with a tree-over-index rule)
run dune build and tests/check.sh in the pinned checker image with networking off
run ./oft check coturn/FuzzStunClient --parts statements,proofs and record wall time and peak memory
pin one Verus commit and record it with the benchmark revision
verify the reference proofs of all 849 with-lemma tasks, or a subset fixed by task ID before the run
record wall time and peak memory per task and keep infrastructure failures separate
insert assume, admit, and external_body into the target, or weaken its specification, and confirm the guard rejects each one
freeze a development-only protocol for Leanstral-1.5 under its native agent configuration and for one other open-weight model named before the run
run it on development repositories only under the existing grader and containment contract
report strict support and mixed specification groups per endpoint without opening qualification or prospective repositories

fifth_source_survey.gate: official code, an executable verifier, and a meaningful downstream training or environment decision

entries.name: VeruSAGE-Bench with VeruSyn data
entries.reason: Published family-disjoint data-composition study on an open base model with released candidate datasets.

entries.name: PSV (Propose-Solve-Verify)
entries.reason: Strong experimental design, but no license file and toy-scale tasks.

entries.name: Re:Form and DafnyComp
entries.reason: Full open training stack, but the endpoint is specification generation and environment choice is not the studied variable.

entries.name: Goedel-Code-Prover
entries.reason: Consumes other benchmarks. Its 8B model is a candidate trainable Lean starting policy.

entries.name: AlgoVeri
entries.reason: 77 algorithms are too few for several candidate environments.

entries.name: Verina
entries.reason: Evaluation target only, close to saturation for open-weight provers.

entries.name: FVAPPS
entries.reason: Stale toolchain and no reference proofs.

entries.name: SAFE
entries.reason: Its data is one VeruSyn comparison arm in microsoft/Verus_Training_Data.

entries.name: VeriBench
entries.conflict_of_interest: VeriBench comes from the research group of this repository's owner. Any qualification needs an independent auditor.
entries.reason: Not audited here because of the conflict of interest.
